model_annotation: The plot illustrates the distribution of counts across various polarity scores. The x-axis is labeled "Polarity scores" and uses a linear scale with numeric tick marks spaced at intervals of 0.2, ranging from -1.0 to 0.6. The plotted values along this axis span from approximately -1.1 to 0.55. The y-axis represents "Counts" on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 50000 with tick labels positioned at regular intervals of 10000. The data is represented by a single solid blue line with filled circular markers. The line begins at an x-value of approximately -1.1 with a y-value near 0 and remains relatively flat until x = -0.7. It then exhibits a minor peak of roughly 4500 at x = -0.55 before dipping slightly to around 2000 at x = -0.35. From this point, the line climbs steeply to reach its highest peak exactly at x = 0.0 with a count of nearly 49000. Following this maximum, the line drops sharply to approximately 18000 at x = 0.09, rises to a secondary peak of roughly 28000 at x = 0.18, and then undergoes a steep decline to near 500 at x = 0.36. The line forms one final, smaller peak of approximately 9500 at x = 0.45 before concluding at an x-value of roughly 0.55 with a count near 500.
